fixed_overlay_risks.evidence: Fixed or sticky element covers about 100% of the viewport.
fixed_overlay_risks.suggested_fix: Reduce this persistent UI or make it part of the scrollable scene.

design_review.summary: Visual QA found high-priority design risks.

evidence.evidence: Fixed or sticky UI covers about 100% of the viewport area.
evidence.suggested_fix: Shrink fixed UI and move persistent status into the scene so it does not compete with the main activity.

evidence.evidence: 11 card-like white panels and 0 large white panels detected.
evidence.suggested_fix: Collapse repeated white panels into scene-specific frames, boards, machines, or inline status areas.

evidence.evidence: 14 buttons are present and 71% look like generic rounded web buttons.
evidence.suggested_fix: Restyle primary controls as story objects such as tickets, machine keys, panels, or reward controls.
